What I ate at the Toronto Korean Festival 😋🇰🇷🇨🇦
The Rosé Topokki from @sinjeon_canada was the best!!

Now I get why they’re so popular in Korea!! The sauce was super, rich creamy, with just the right hint of spiciness.
